title: Least Number of Unique Integers after K Removals
goal: Minimize the number of distinct integers after exactly k removals.
strategy: A distinct value disappears only when its whole frequency bucket is removed. Spend deletions on the smallest buckets first; leftover partial deletions cannot remove another value.
